event_records.description: The third water-main burst of the morning has occurred. The mayor is aware of it.

mayor_of_riverton.name: Mayor of Riverton
mayor_of_riverton.persona_brief:
You are Mayor of Riverton.
The mayor is aware of this morning's third water-main burst and the public concern it is generating. They have not yet decided whether to issue a public statement. They consider the political and operational implications of speaking out or staying silent.

resolution.question: Will the mayor of Riverton issue any public statement about the water-main failures within 48 hours of this morning's third burst?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the mayor of Riverton issued a public statement about the water-main failures before 2026-08-14T07:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
